text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(I thought I bought 10% apple juice... I 
misread the label...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"With this packaging, I can't believe... 
it was actually 100% fruit juice!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...That's just like a real apple! I'm 
still not worthy of it...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if Cheval-san would drink 
this... *sigh*...
